description: This file defines the interface for the xrsv_http module, which manages HTTP-based speech request handling in the VREX speech system. It includes macro definitions, data structures for input parameters, received messages, callback handler types, and function prototypes for creating, configuring, and destroying the speech request handler. It also declares callback registration functions and update functions for various parameters such as device ID, receiver ID, partner ID, application ID, language, and PII masking.

methods.name: xrsv_http_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes an HTTP-based VREX speech request handler instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handlers
methods.description: Registers application callback handlers and produces XRSR-compatible handler table for integration.

methods.name: xrsv_http_update_user_data
methods.description: Updates the user data pointer passed to callback functions.

methods.name: xrsv_http_update_device_id
methods.description: Updates the device ID used by the handler.

methods.name: xrsv_http_update_receiver_id
methods.description: Updates the receiver ID used by the handler.

methods.name: xrsv_http_update_partner_id
methods.description: Updates the partner ID used by the handler.

methods.name: xrsv_http_destroy
methods.description: Closes and releases resources associated with the handler instance.
